platformId.description: Stable platform identity assigned by the trusted Programmable projection. This is not creator metadata.

registeredRecordHash.description: Immutable record hash carried by the canonical Registry registration event.

registeredRecordCommitment.description: Keccak-256 over the canonical Solidity ABI registered-record component hashes. Equal to registeredRecordHash for Registry v3 records.

projectionDigest.description: Digest of this mutable public projection revision, including lifecycle and finality state.

provider.description: Optional launch-provider attribution. It never establishes Programmable origin, category, partner fee state, template approval, review status, or executable support. Only verificationStatus=registry-bound with a non-null evidenceHash is authenticated provider provenance.

launchedVia.description: Optional immutable display projection of the finalized Custom Launch API partnerAttribution snapshot. It is server-derived from the authenticated partner API principal and cannot be supplied by the launch request. It does not establish economic partner, provider, review, safety, liquidity, tradeability, or external index status.

token.description: ERC-20 convenience projection when the authenticated launch advertises exactly one primary token. Null for truthful project-only launches.

assets.description: Identity-first authenticated asset graph. Optional on legacy v1 records.

definition.const: Reviewed against the published Programmable security policy and cryptographically bound to the exact deployed contract revision.
Reviewed against the published Programmable security policy and cryptographically bound to the exact deployed contract revision.

timestamp.description: Block timestamp enrichment. Null does not hide an otherwise verified launcher event.
